1.note: No signal; picked the abstract material property over two concrete nouns and 'wealth'.

2.note: 'sentimental' is a register throwaway but that leaves three equal analytic adjectives; no way to choose.

3.note: faithful/exacting/literal all sit on a strictness axis; 'idiomatic' is the one term naming the opposite pole, which is where a translation passage lands.

4.note: equivocal/derivative/inconsequential are all plainly pejorative verdicts; 'idiosyncratic' is the only neutral-to-positive one, so it is the odd member.

5.note: mutation/advantage/time read as a stock evolutionary triad and 'compounds' is the grammatical outlier, but which side of that is the key is a coin flip.

6.note: withstands/measures/requires are literal; 'invites' is the figurative academic verb ('invites scrutiny') such a sentence builds toward.

7.note: 'coeval' is the precise chronological term; successive is its antonym and the other two are generic, so the set looks built around it.

8.note: 'provisional' is the natural hedge for a scientific conclusion, but representative and incontrovertible are equally live; no structural tell.

9.note: 'dispositive' is the rare epistemic term of art; the others are ordinary descriptors, and the rare term is what a passage about weighing evidence names.

10.note: 'recipe' is the concrete metaphor among person/lineage/trade, but that could as easily mark it a distractor.

11.note: no signal; exposed/resented/corrected all take a rule or flaw as object, and so does obeyed.

12.note: unusual/imaginary/irrelevant are all dismissals; 'unmeasured' is the only methodological status, i.e. real-but-undetected, which is the interesting claim.

13.note: incomplete/unwarranted/premature are degrees of insufficiency; 'circular' names a specific fallacy and is the odd member.

14.note: decisive/plausible/fanciful form a credibility ladder and 'secondary' is the outlier, but I could not tell which side the blank sits on.

15.note: 'unanswerable' is the strongest claim about a limit of inquiry, but malformed and academic are equally available; no real signal.

16.note: reversible/predictable/gradual all describe a process's trajectory; 'accidental' describes its cause, so it is the odd axis.

17.note: decay/evaporation/drainage are all removal-of-material processes; 'settlement' is the mechanical one, and it recurs in item 1, suggesting a built-environment passage.

18.note: forgotten/abandoned and surpassed pair off as literal fates; 'outgrown' is the one figurative term, the register such a sentence reaches for.

19.note: machinery/frugality/prosperity are economic; 'spareness' is the only aesthetic term, and the set reads as built off a style word.

20.note: publicize/chronicle/instruct are outward acts on an audience; 'discern' is the only inward act of perception, so it is the odd one.

21.note: preserved/translated/disciplined all presuppose a prior thing handed on; 'invented' denies it, which is the claim an 'invented tradition' passage makes.
